notes.title: Major update for Mpirimpa
notes.content:
🎉 Mpirimpa Update – Fresh Look & New Features!
Hello everyone! 👋

We’re excited to share a brand-new update for Mpirimpa that makes the game more fun, more social, and smoother than ever:

✨ What’s New

🎨 New Graphics – enjoy a refreshed look that makes every match feel even better.

💬 Improved Chat – connect with friends and opponents more easily with our upgraded in-game chat system.

🏳️ Resign Button – no more waiting around if you want to end early — you can now resign gracefully.

This is just the beginning! We’re working on more updates to keep Mpirimpa growing and to make your matches as enjoyable as possible.

👉 Jump in, try out the new features, and let us know what you think in the Community Hub or Discord!

Thanks for playing,
❤️ The Spectrum Games Team
